research_scope: Diagnose information carriers before choosing dependency-aware recurrent/attention co-design; retain matched-cost write-side and read-side methods as candidates.
intervention: Keep the full original input, positions and prefix computation. At every full-attention layer, question/answer rows may access prelude/instruction tokens and causal question/answer tokens, but none of the historical ledger-record KV positions. GDN and convolution updates remain unchanged.
mask_inputs: Only fixed prelude tokenizer boundaries and the registered ledger boundary; no dependency indices, fact values, answers or per-case failure information.
required_checks: Validate and hash every token mask before inference, using all existing contexts and frozen checkpoint identities.
All-history masks exactly reproduce the reference full-cache/logit/scoring/generation behavior on sampled short and long cases.
Records-blocked masks preserve original prefix cache/logits and all historical KV tensors on the sampled full-prefill cases.
Restrictions apply to every cached scoring/generation forward, with no future-token access.
Replay reference raw-full scores before reusing them; check reference manifest/result/checkpoint hashes.
Report raw-full, oracle-evidence and records-blocked results by depth, wording, late order, initialization and base-fact pairs. Bootstrap by the 24 base facts.

interpretation.success: The frozen full hybrid can answer these queries from carriers available after historical record KV access is blocked, including recurrent/convolution states built during ordinary hybrid prefix processing. This is not a claim about isolated GDN matrices or arbitrary semantic/history tasks.
interpretation.failure: The frozen computation did not recover the answer under this intervention; it does not prove the state lacks that information, because the readout can be distribution-shifted.
interpretation.cost: Dense eager masking remains a diagnostic, not a latency/memory benchmark or deployable routing result.

followups: Control values and initial-record positions when testing target-initial versus unrelated-initial interference on fresh facts.
Include source-update-before/after-COPY positive controls and initial-version questions, so a fixed earliest-value shortcut cannot qualify as semantic update competence.
Compare ordinary data augmentation/local adaptation, learned evidence access and dependency-aware write/read co-design at matched training/parameter/runtime budgets.
Oracle access success does not rule out a useful write-side architecture: require an advantage over practical matched-cost controls, rather than requiring oracle access to fail.
